method: HOG + spatial HSV colour histogram + linear SVM (one-vs-rest)
hardware: Apple M4 Pro, 12 cores, 24 GB RAM
notes: Inference time covers the full pipeline: JPEG decode, resize to 128x128, HOG descriptor, spatial HSV histogram, L2 normalisation and the linear SVM decision function.
Feature extraction and one-vs-rest SVM fitting both ran with 12 joblib workers, so all timings are wall clock on a fully loaded 12-core CPU rather than single-core time.
Validation feature extraction (5000 images, 2.688 s) supported the C sweep and is excluded from training time, which reports the cost of producing the final model only.
The four-value C sweep for this configuration cost roughly 368 s of additional SVM fitting.

sources.feature_extraction_seconds: {train,test}_color_info.json in the feature cache directory named by COMP9517_FEATURES_DIR (git ignored; absolute path omitted because it is machine specific)
